leads.title: ILGA-Europe 2025 report
leads.documents: Ranks status of LGBTQ rights in Poland as among the worst of EU countries; baseline for overall legal climate.
leads.detail: Cited in article lead as "According to ILGA-Europe's 2025 report" - no URL visible in text

leads.title: Constitution of Poland, Article 18
leads.documents: Defines marriage as union of man and woman under protection of Republic; interpreted by Supreme Court, Constitutional Tribunal and Supreme Administrative Court as limiting marriage to opposite-sex couples and requiring constitutional amendment for same-sex marriage.
leads.detail: Cited as "Article 18 of the Polish Constitution states that 'Marriage, as a union of a man and a woman...'" - no URL visible

leads.title: European Court of Human Rights - Andersen v. Poland (2025), Formela v. Poland (2024), Przybyszewska and Others v. Poland (2023), Szypula and Others v. Poland (2025)
leads.documents: Documents ECHR obligation on Poland to provide legal framework/recognition for same-sex unions, registration of foreign marriage, certificates of no impediment, and hardships of non-recognition/legal limbo.
leads.detail: Cited by case names and years; also Gruszczynski-Regowski and Others v. Poland (2025) Art.37 strike-out and Andersen v. Poland notification July 2020 - no URL visible

leads.title: Court of Justice of the EU - judgment 25 November 2025; Coman v Romania (2018); ECJ June 2018 residency ruling
leads.documents: Documents EU-law duty to recognize same-sex marriages legally concluded in another Member State where freedom of movement exercised, and full residency/freedom of movement rights for married same-sex couples with EU citizen.
leads.detail: Cited as "In a judgment of November 25, 2025, the CJEU ruled..." based on Coman, and "In June 2018, the European Court of Justice ruled..." - no URL visible

leads.title: Supreme Administrative Court ruling 20 March 2026 / Warsaw registry implementation 14 May 2026; Constitutional Tribunal ruling 28 July 2026
leads.documents: Documents conflicting enforcement machinery: administrative court ordering civil-registry offices to recognise/transcribe EU same-sex marriage certificates vs Tribunal ruling transcription incompatible with Constitution.
leads.detail: Cited with dates "On 20 March 2026..." "first implemented...14 May 2026" "on July 28, 2026..." - no URL visible

leads.title: Supreme Court Civil Chamber resolution 4 March 2025 on legal gender change; Penal Code art.156 §1; Sejm transgender bill veto October 2015
leads.documents: Documents transgender rights machinery: prior requirement to sue parents and need medical diagnosis, hormone therapy before surgery due to infertility-prohibition; 2025 simplification to non-trial rectification of vital records with immediate effect; 2015 bill (252-158 Sejm, Senate approval) vetoed by President Andrzej Duda.
leads.detail: Cited as "On 4 March 2025, the Civil Chamber..." "Kodeks Karny art. 156 §1" "In July 2015, the Polish Sejm approved..." - no URL visible

leads.title: Anti-discrimination framework: Labour Code 2003 amendment; Constitution equality clause; Equal Treatment Act 1 Jan 2011; Amnesty International September 2015
leads.documents: Documents employment-only protection for sexual orientation, rejected 1995 constitutional inclusion, 2007 draft law limits, and institutional finding that LGBTI face widespread discrimination and legal system falls short on hate-crime protection; legal scholar Marcin Gorski finding equal treatment ineffective 2015-2020.
leads.detail: Cited as "Anti-discrimination provisions were added to the Labour Code in 2003" "On 1 January 2011, a new law on equal treatment entered into force" "In September 2015, Amnesty International concluded..." - no URL visible

leads.title: Hate-crime / public-accommodation enforcement: Supreme Court Lodz printer June 2018; Constitutional Tribunal 26 June 2019; hate-crime bill veto 17 April 2025
leads.documents: Documents enforcement gap: printer refusal ruled illegal then authorizing provision found unconstitutional; no current health-services/hate-crime protections; pending enhancement for gender, gender identity, sexual orientation; PM Donald Tusk Nov 2024 agreement then President Andrzej Duda veto.
leads.detail: Cited as "In June 2018, the Polish Supreme Court ruled..." "On 26 June 2019, the Tribunal..." "On 17 April 2025, President Andrzej Duda vetoed the bill" - no URL visible

leads.title: EU Agency for Fundamental Rights 2019 EU LGBTI Survey II; 2023 Eurobarometer; GLOBSEC March 2023
leads.documents: Documents lived-risk indicators for visitors: 83% avoid holding hands, 51% avoid locations for fear of assault (highest EU), 15% attacked in 5 years (highest EU), 1 in 5 trans/intersex attacked, 4% believe government combats prejudice (lowest EU), largest life-satisfaction gap.
leads.detail: Cited as "According to Polish respondents to the European Union Agency for Fundamental Rights 2019 EU LGBTI survey II" and "The 2023 Eurobarometer found..." - no URL visible

leads.title: Bialystok Equality March violence 20 July 2019; 'free from LGBT ideology' resolutions repealed 6 Feb 2024
leads.documents: Documents documented incident risk: ~800 marchers confronted by >4,000 counter-protesters throwing stones, bricks, firecrackers, bottles requiring riot police; and state-tolerated hostile zones - 100 councils by April 2020, last repealed by Warsaw Voivodship Administrative Court.
leads.detail: Cited as "On 20 July 2019, a violent counter-protest...Police estimated..." with eyewitness/journalist/monitor documentation, and "by 6th February 2024 Warsaw Voivodship Administrative Court repealed..." - no URL visible
